loop.observation: Loop refresh dispatch can discover non-workflow refresh commands that safe GitHub workflow dispatch cannot execute.
loop.hypothesis: Ignored refresh commands should be emitted as redacted closed-loop candidates with source_ref, run, adoption_plan, and verifier command binding.
loop.execute: Generate a dispatch plan and optional candidate artifact from loop-refresh-commands without shell-evaluating command strings.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on stale source evidence, unsafe workflow command parsing, missing ignored command details, missing candidate source refs, or missing adoption commands.
loop.retrospective: This keeps workflow dispatch safe while preventing target verifier commands from falling back into human memory.
